title: fix(plugin-charts): an object-chart whose family is on specType gets compareTo as its chartType twin does (objectui#11530)
body:
Fixes #11530

Clause-②: no

Dispatched by the PM loop, round 1 (`domain:ui` seat 1), claim comment `5965044944`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`. Triage ruling `5964859128` executed as written.

## The defect, reproduced at BASE `06634afe7`

`ObjectChart` gates the comparison fetch (`wantsComparison`) and the overlay series (`enableComparisonSeries`) on `chartTypeIgnoresCompareTo(schema.chartType)`. A family on `specType` was invisible to both. Measured through the real `SchemaRenderer` with the final pin and `ObjectChart.tsx` at BASE:

- The card's document (`properties` bag, `specType: scatter`, `compareTo: { kind: 'previousYear' }`): **2** aggregate calls, then the `scatter-multi-series` refusal "A scatter plots one measure. Keep exactly one series: amount, amount__comparison", with no chart surface.
- `specType` set to `pie`, `donut` or `funnel`: **2** calls, and one pie (or funnel) drawn. The comparison rows are never drawn.
- The `chartType` twins: **1** call each, and the scatter draws.

## The fix

- **One reader.** `chartFamily = normalizeChartSchema(schema, language).chartType`, memoised at component scope. That is the value `ChartRenderer` dispatches on (`schema.chartType ?? spec.chartType` over the same normalizer: `chartType`, else `specType`), so the gates read the family the chart is drawn as. It was already importable, so `normalizeChartSchema.ts` is untouched and nothing new is exported. There is no hand-rolled `chartType ?? specType`.
- **One list.** Both gates read that family through `chartTypeIgnoresCompareTo`. Its family list in `@object-ui/core` is untouched (objectui#7495).
- **The fetch key.** The fetch callback's dependency list keys on `chartFamily` instead of `schema.chartType`: it is the input of the same compare decision. A `specType` family change now re-runs the fetch under the new family's gate.
- `language` is passed although no label is read off the result, so `resolveChartCategoryField` stays the package's one call without it, as the comment beside it says.
- **Where `specType` sits.** The `SchemaRenderer` properties hoist copies `properties.*` flat onto the node before `ObjectChart` sees it, and `normalizeChartSchema` reads the flat key. So the bag form and the flat forms reach the same reader. The pin covers each shape.

No other `schema.chartType` read in `ObjectChart.tsx` decides behaviour. The three code reads before the change were the two gates and the fetch key; after it there are none.

## Pins

`packages/plugin-charts/src/__tests__/object-chart-compareto-spectype-11530.test.tsx` (new), through the real `SchemaRenderer` and this package's registrations. Every expectation is read off `chartTypeIgnoresCompareTo`; no family list is restated.

- **Per object-path shape** (the `properties` bag, which is the card's document; the dashboard producer's flat node; the react-page wrapper's node):
  - `specType: scatter` with `compareTo` draws one scatter after 1 call, with no refusal;
  - `specType: pie` makes 1 call;
  - CONTROL: `specType: bar` makes 2 calls and draws 2 bars (the overlay);
  - CONTROL: the `chartType` twins answer scatter 1, pie 1, bar 2 with the overlay.
- **The flat node with inline rows that already carry the comparison column.** It fetches nothing, so it isolates the overlay gate. `specType: scatter` draws instead of refusing; CONTROL: `bar` on both channels draws the overlay.
- **Every spec family (20) on the card's document:** `specType` makes the call count `chartTypeIgnoresCompareTo` predicts, the same as `chartType`, and shows the same form.
- **The dataset node** (scatter, pie, bar): both channels make the same calls and show the same form.
- **A `specType` family change, bar to pie:** 2 calls, then exactly 1 more, and the pie drawn.
- **Premise:** the card's document parses on `safeValidateSchema` and `StrictAnyComponentSchema` with scatter, pie and bar on `specType`.

## Reverse verification and ablation (predicted first, all at committed head `4589e68c0`)

The subject resolves to `src` through the vitest alias, so no `dist` leg applies. The three mutations went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob moved; restore proven by blob equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`). The BASE leg was `git checkout 06634afe7 -- ObjectChart.tsx`, restored with `git checkout HEAD --` and the same two proofs.

| leg | prediction | reading |
|---|---|---|
| **BASE** `ObjectChart.tsx` | red: 3 shapes x (scatter, pie), inline scatter, the 4 ignoring families in the matrix, the re-run row = 12 | **12 failed, 28 passed (40)**, exactly those |
| **A1:** the fetch gate back to `schema.chartType` | the 6 shape rows, the 4 matrix rows, and the re-run row (it re-runs, then fetches the comparison) = 11; inline scatter stays green | **11 failed, 29 passed (40)**, exactly those |
| **A2:** the overlay gate back to `schema.chartType` | only inline scatter (the object paths never get the column) | **1 failed, 39 passed (40)**, that one |
| **A3:** the fetch key back to `schema.chartType` | only the re-run row (calls stay at 2) | **1 failed, 39 passed (40)**, that one |

## Gates (at `4589e68c0`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/` plus every test naming `compareTo` or `chartTypeIgnoresCompareTo` (`git grep -l`; 17 outside plugin-charts, in console, core, data-objectstack, plugin-dashboard, react and types): **106 files, 1889 passed, 9 skipped**.
- `pnpm turbo run build --filter='./packages/*'` (39 of 39; plugin-charts, plugin-dashboard, runner and app-shell rebuilt), then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose file list includes the new pin): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build`, the `Bundle Analysis` program (`tsc`, vite build, SDUI manifest, `tsconfig.plugin.json`): exit 0.
- Exit 0 with their own verdict lines: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `changeset:check`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:self-import`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:esm-specifiers` (specifier leg), `check:sdui-registration-pins`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:shell-escape-residue` and `check:i18n-keys`.
- `check:changeset-claims` (report-only) named 4 pending changesets that cite `ObjectChart.tsx`: `8650-chart-foreign-dialect-retired`, `8885-object-chart-drilldown-title-compareto`, `humanize-label-single-home-5444` and `objectchart-schema-anchor-7946`. Each paragraph was read. None says how the compare gate reads the family, so none goes false.
- **Lint, a declared narrowing.** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the changed files read 3 entries:
  - the 2 TS files, 0 errors. `ObjectChart.tsx` has 41 warnings, the same 41 by rule as BASE (linted through `--stdin`). The pin has 2, both `no-explicit-any` in the `vi.mock('recharts')` block, the sibling pattern;
  - the changeset, which the config ignores.
  - The population is the root flat config: plugin-charts' `lint` is `eslint .` and the package has no config of its own. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide lint belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **What an accepted document does differently:** `specType: scatter` with `compareTo` draws instead of refusing; `specType` set to `pie`, `donut` or `funnel` stops the unused comparison fetch, with the same picture. A family on `chartType`, and every family that keeps `compareTo` on either key, is unchanged. Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-charts` `patch`.
- **Route:** the ruling's effective family is read through `normalizeChartSchema`, which is already exported and already called by this file. Exporting the family expression on its own was the claim's fallback and was not needed.
- **`Clause-②: no` holds:** no exported type moves; the change is inside the component body.
- **The overlay gate alone** is reachable only when the rows already carry the comparison column (inline or bound rows with an `aggregate`). The pin's inline shape is that case, built to isolate it.
- **Noted, not filed:** the dataset-bound path of `ObjectChart` forwards no `compareTo` to `queryDataset` for any family. The pin holds only that both channels agree there. `compareTo` on `object-chart` is declared INTERNAL (relay-composed by `DashboardRenderer`), and no producer of a dataset-bound `object-chart` with `compareTo` was measured. Carrier: none.
- **Docs:** nothing under `content/docs`, in the package README or under `skills/` mentions `compareTo`, so no doc moves.
